item.title: Weekly Wrap: A record close and 3.7% month a big thumbs up
item.description: ASX 200 finishes at record close, up 3.7% in Feb as BHP profits beat and banks top forecasts; Block rockets on staff cuts; rare-earths rally lifts Lynas/Iluka.

item.title: Time for Pensioners to Get Aggressive
item.description: Pensioners urged to be aggressive with cash as March deeming rates rise to 1.25% and 3.25%; beating returns could protect income.

item.title: Galan Lithium Advances Hombre Muerto West Phase 1 Construction to 92% Completion
item.description: Galan Lithium advances Hombre Muerto West Phase 1 to 92% completion, moving into testing; first lithium concentrate expected in H1 2026, with H2 2026 shipment.

item.title: US-Iran War: Energy, Gold, and Silver
item.description: Oil jumps as US-Iran tensions flare; Hormuz risk, insurers drop cover. Gold, silver and miners rally as a new mining bull market awakens.

item.title: The Weekly Finger: CBA PR team dancing in the streets, waving flags etc
item.description: CBA faces police probe over a $1bn mortgage-fraud hole, sparking talk of a banking lending overhaul and potential share moves.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Reports Outstanding Antimony-Gold Results at Thompson Falls
item.description: Red Mountain Mining (ASX: RMX) reports standout Thompson Falls antimony-gold results: up to 36.5% Sb and 1.12 g/t Au; stibnite 47.3% Sb, US Tier-1 potential.

item.title: Vinyl Group to Boost Adaptive Media Strategy with Val Morgan Digital Acquisition
item.description: VNL to acquire Val Morgan Digital for $10.5m, boosting revenue ~73% and expanding ANZ licenses; AI publishing catalysts ahead for FY26.

item.title: Resolution Minerals Completes Johnson Creek Mill and Tungsten Stockpile Acquisition
item.description: Resolution Minerals (ASX: RML) completes Johnson Creek mill and tungsten stockpile acquisition, fast-tracking US antimony, tungsten and gold production.

item.title: Jade Gas Concludes Appraisal Program, Eyes Maiden Reserve Booking
item.description: Jade Gas ends TTCBM appraisal in Mongolia, submits Red Lake report and eyes maiden gas reserve booking within a week to unlock PDO and LNG plans.

item.title: Catalina Resources Hits High-Grade Gold in First Yerilgee Drill Hole
item.description: Catalina Resources reports 48m @2.61 g/t Au from 15m at Yerilgee Chicken Little; 8m @11.6 g/t Au from 42m; mineralisation open at depth, momentum.
